name: Rebuking
overview: Scripture teaches that rebuking is a vital expression of love and wisdom, intended to correct and restore rather than to condemn. Open and faithful rebuke, as contrasted with deceitful flattery, builds wisdom and strengthens relationships, as a wise person receives correction with love. The practice of rebuking evil includes gently confronting a brother who has sinned, with the goal of reconciliation and spiritual growth. God's Spirit is poured out to those who respond to reproof, highlighting the redemptive purpose behind rebuking.
